scope: Read-only source and theme audit; no image, theme or store mutations performed by this audit.

provenance.currentPixelOverrides: Six catalogue-polish background replacements preserve Shopify filenames and file references. activeLocalPath identifies the served replacement source; snapshot URL cache versions predate that edit.
provenance.externalAccess: No fresh catalogue network read; current list reconciles saved snapshot with confirmed catalogue-polish deployment manifests.
provenance.paths: All asset paths are relative to repository root.

warm_bone_headwear.backdrop: Warm Bone seamless with restrained contact shadow; previously replaced in place.
warm_bone_headwear.framing: Large frontal beanies and bucket hats; full silhouette, narrow side margins.
warm_bone_headwear.recommendedAction: Retain assets; verify common card fit and padding.

pale_studio_apparel.framing: Full front quarter-zip or polo, fills most square canvas.
pale_studio_apparel.recommendedAction: Four highest-priority apparel background outliers; preserve product and framing.

phrase_apparel.backdrop: Pale warm neutral studio, without strong diagonal sun bands.
phrase_apparel.framing: Full garment in 1312x1199 canvas, often narrow side margins; Rest Is Ours uses back view.
phrase_apparel.recommendedAction: Contain within square cards; preserve front/back view. No forced source regeneration.

ours_landscape_caps.framing: Three-quarter cap in 1536x1024 landscape, brim close to edge.
ours_landscape_caps.recommendedAction: Contain within square cards to avoid 33.3% horizontal crop; retain source assets.

for_a_reason_caps.backdrop: Golden beige with stronger directional light/shadow than surrounding assets.
for_a_reason_caps.framing: Large three-quarter caps within square canvas.
for_a_reason_caps.recommendedAction: Three priority headwear background outliers; unify backdrop only.

original_caps.backdrop: Light warm cream seamless with soft ground shadow; inferred siblings may vary.
original_caps.framing: Large three-quarter cap, generally narrow side margins.
original_caps.recommendedAction: Retain assets; verify common card fit and padding.

original_jackets.backdrop: Pale warm cream studio; no pronounced sunlight bands in inspected navy lead.
original_jackets.framing: Full front hooded jacket very close to canvas edges.
original_jackets.recommendedAction: Retain initially; card padding addresses tight framing. Revisit only if live QA shows a distracting pale patch.

original_apparel.backdrop: Warm beige with diagonal sunlight or soft foliage shadows in inspected representatives.
original_apparel.framing: Full front flat lay; tops fill width, sweatpants narrower with more side space.
original_apparel.recommendedAction: Retain assets; common square card, contain and modest padding first.

theme.collectionRatioAtAuditStart: adapt; root subsequently confirmed native Auto and saved Square
theme.nativeImagePadding: Existing card/gallery padding is zero. No native object-fit setting in card-gallery schema.
theme.hover: Historical settings enable show_second_image_on_hover; include second images in live preview QA.
theme.appliedStateCaveat: Source audit is read-only. Root owns current live settings and final CSS deployment verification.
theme.ratioEvidence: card-gallery inline --gallery-aspect-ratio is consumed by shared .product-media-container aspect-ratio; important overrides inline ratio across card surfaces.
theme.verifiedInsetRule: .card-gallery .product-media-container.media-fit { background: #ECE5D3; } .card-gallery .product-media-container.media-fit img.product-media__image { object-fit: contain; object-position: center; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 4%; }

recommendedScope.first: Apply common square card geometry, scoped contain fit and consistent modest padding; verify desktop and mobile including hover.
recommendedScope.sourceEdits: Only seven clearest backdrop outliers initially: three For a Reason caps and four near-white quarter-zip/polo images. Preserve garments, designs, colours, view and material.
recommendedScope.verificationScope: 32 lead cards and hover/secondary previews, using this complete 86-image inventory as coverage.
recommendedScope.preserve: Do not change production artwork, supplier mockups used outside this storefront, product variants, prices, fulfilment or Printful configuration.
